name: Galvanized steel staples; at plant
description: Unit process for hot-dipped galvanized steel staple production. No loss is included. Assumes that staples are produced at the same factory as the galvanized steel. Electricity consumption based on the Uniwin N/K/P Series Staple Making Machine Data Sheet.
category: 31-33: Manufacturing/3312: Steel Product Manufacturing from Purchased Steel

processDocumentation.modelingConstantsDescription: Electricity data from manufacturer's product data sheet.
processDocumentation.completenessDescription: This process was developed based off product data sheets. The treatment of missing data is unknown. The mass imbalance is 0%. No loss was included.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Data was collected from product data sheets.
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: Assumptions for electricity calculations are included in the exchange description. Assumed that staples are produced at the same factory as the galvanized steel.
processDocumentation.samplingDescription: Includes staple production energy usage and material. Excludes loss and transport to user.

sources.name: Uniwin (2025) N/K/P Series Staple Making Machine Data Sheet

processDocumentation.intendedApplication: Situation C1 - Accounting, with system-external interactions - The intended application is a purely descriptive accounting / documentation of the analysed system including existing interactions with other systems in the LCI model.
